_doc: DIFFICULTY. Enemy stats scale with: the chosen level (levels.<id>), the stage (stages[idx]), the room's step within the stage (step_ramp per step), room kind (kinds.elite/boss), and a gentle TUTORIAL floor for the first rooms of stage 1. hp = base * level.hp * stage.hp * (1 + step_ramp*step) * kind.hp; flat damage bonus = level.dmg + stage.dmg + kind.dmg (never below -1 / the tutorial value). 'extra' = chance (per fought normal room, seeded, never in tutorial rooms) that one more enemy of the room's own kind joins; level.extra adds to it. 'hunger' multiplies the hunger paid per room (not in the tutorial). 'forage' multiplies hunger from forage/corpses. Changing numbers here is the way to rebalance; tests/sim.gd reports win rates.
